author: Unreal Engine
description:
Unreal Engine’s built-in profiling tools are essential, but some mobile performance questions require visibility beyond the engine itself. 

This session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 shows how to use platform-native profilers on iOS and Android to analyze CPU, GPU, memory, and power consumption in Unreal Engine mobile projects. 

Watch to learn practical workflows for capturing and interpreting platform traces and correlating them with Unreal Engine performance analysis tooling. The session demonstrates when engine-agnostic data is needed alongside Unreal Insights, and how to turn low-level platform information into actionable engine, rendering, and content optimizations.

Find out more about using Unreal Engine to develop mobile games here: unrealengine.com/uses/mobile-games

#MobileGames, #Profiling, #iOS, #Android, #UnrealInsights, #MobileGameDevelopment, #UnrealEngine, #UnrealFestChicago2026
title: Profiling Unreal Engine on Mobile with Platform-Native Tools | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
For two decades, the GEICO Gecko has existed and developed at the highest end of the traditional CG pipeline: crafted for broadcast commercials where quality is paramount and render time is secondary. 

In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, VFX studio Framestore pulls back the curtain on how that iconic character is being re-engineered for a real-time future. Framestore converted the Gecko from a classic offline-rendered asset into a fully optimized, high-fidelity real-time character powered by Unreal Engine, without sacrificing the nuance, personality, or polish audiences expect. 

The talk walks through the full character progression: from model optimization to refining animation systems and adapting shading and lighting for real-time performance. Grounded in artistry as much as technology, the session highlights how creative decisions evolve when characters need to perform live, interactively, and at speed.

title: When Mascots Go Live: Converting the GEICO Gecko to Real-Time | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
